name: 5-IAI
summary: A monoamine triple releaser first synthesised by David Nichols, possesses similar properties to MDMA. It is suspected to be neurotoxic however more research is needed to say.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: The drug acts as a serotonin-norepinephrine-dopamine releasing agent (SNDRA) and produces much less serotonergic neurotoxicity than MDMA in animals.

uses.text: It was encountered as a novel recreational designer drug in 2010, but never gained widespread popularity.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs that release serotonin strongly, such as MDMA, can cause jaw clenching, sweating, overheating, nausea, a racing heart and a low mood in the days after. Serious risks include dangerous overheating, low blood sodium from drinking too much water, and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。強烈釋放血清素的藥物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬緊牙關、出汗、體溫過高、噁心、心跳急促，以及之後幾天的情緒低落。嚴重風險包括危險的體溫過高、因喝太多水造成的低血鈉，以及血清素症候群。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。强烈释放血清素的药物（例如MDMA）可能引起咬紧牙关、出汗、体温过高、恶心、心跳急促，以及之后几天的情绪低落。严重风险包括危险的体温过高、因喝太多水造成的低血钠，以及血清素症候群。

fact.en: David Nichols made it by locking MDMA-like structures into a rigid indane ring, part of his search for entactogens that spare serotonin nerve endings in animals.
fact.zh: David Nichols把類似MDMA的結構鎖進僵硬的茚環中而製成它，這是他尋找不傷害動物血清素神經末梢的同理心增強劑的一部分。
fact.zhHans: David Nichols把类似MDMA的结构锁进僵硬的茚环中而制成它，这是他寻找不伤害动物血清素神经末梢的同理心增强剂的一部分。
